BrochureContent.Content:
The Hudson is a brand new development which offers residents ultimate convenience and connectivity, with easy access to excellent retail, nightlife, shopping, entertainment, sporting and cultural venues and within a short journey to a myriad of employers.

Everything is carefully considered at The Hudson, with the aim of giving you the optimal work/life balance whether you are working from home, commuting or enjoying a flexible lifestyle. The Hudson connects you quickly to the very best amenities and activities. Walk, cycle, drive or take the LUAS to bring you where you want to go.

Final Release: Penthouses at The Hudson, Sandyford Central.
These elevated apartments offer breathtaking panoramic views over Dublin City, Dublin and Wicklow mountains and the coastline.
 
Immerse yourself in elegance with our enhanced furniture packages, curated to complement the stunning surroundings of your new home.
 
These apartments are on the higher floors of the elegant Hudson building offering unique perspectives over Dublin city, the bay and mountains.
 
These homes have been designed to enhance your modern, urban lifestyle and are finished to the highest quality with features that simply make life better. Your home experience will be further enhanced with our range of great on-site amenities with excellent connectivity to everything you might need from your local neighbourhood and beyond.
 
Experience spectacular dawn and dusk views of Dublin at The Hudson's private 17th floor residents' lounge with an adjoining outside deck. You will never tire of this magnificent facility. 
 
At The Hudson, thoughtful consideration is given to every detail, all with the goal of providing you with an ideal work/life balance.
The dedicated lifestyle amenity space at The Hudson really set it apart and showcases how the development facilitates modern living whether it's using the fully equipped Gym, relaxing in the sky lounge or working from the state-of the-art Business Centre. The Hudson makes life easy for residents by giving them quick access to great shops, nightlife, entertainment, and more.
The amenity space includes:

- Complimentary WiFi and TV Package
-Enhanced Furniture packages
- Concierge/Residents' Manager
- Fully equipped state of the art TechnoGym equipped Gym
- Resident's Sky Lounge with panoramic views over the city, the coast and the Dublin mountains
- 17th Floor Sun deck
- Stylish business centre/lounge with dedicated work pods
- Parcel delivery facility
- Business Centre (with bookable private rooms and open plan workspaces)
- Community events
- Recycling facilities
- Secure access control
- Environmental waste disposal
 
The Hudson offers apartments that are carefully designed for how we live today.
 
BER rating may vary from unit to unit. Individual unit BER rating available upon request.
 
Please note amenity areas and retail units will open on a phased basis and may not be available for immediate use from the time of occupancy
 
**Please note:
1) There are multiple property types available in this development. The photos shown here may not be of the actual unit available but represent the standard of finish.
 
2) The rent advertised on the individual property ads represent the starting rent for these property types. Rents will vary throughout the development depending on the specific property type. Not all the available properties and rents are listed here; please use those available at viewings.
 
3) The overall BER Rating on this development is A Rated, an individual BER cert for your specific apartment is available on move in, upon request.
 
4) Amenities are subject to different opening times than apartment move in dates and are tied in with overall development time frame and may be subject to change.
